Title: Public Preview: Los Angeles - Azure Extended Zones

Body.Content:
We are announcing the public preview of the Los Angeles Azure Extended Zone.

Azure Extended Zones are small-footprint extensions of Azure placed in metros, industry centers, or a specific jurisdiction to serve low latency and data residency workloads. They support virtual machines (VMs), containers, storage, and a selected set of Azure services and can run latency-sensitive and throughput-intensive applications close to end users and within approved data residency boundaries.

You can learn more about how to onboard the public preview and start testing the performance of Azure Extended Zones in our learn page.
